requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Getting started with Memotto"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memotto is a note-taking app that brings text, tables and images together in one place."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide uses examples from Yamanashi in PR and Takanashi in Sales to explain."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "A short note attached to a page is called a \"Quick Note\"."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Ms. Yamanashi records the decisions from meetings in a Quick Note."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Ms. Yamanashi puts Sticky notes on important parts as markers."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You can add up to ten short notes per page."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Used by the team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Mr. Takanashi's sales team first created a Space."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The place inside a Space that everyone can see is called \"Commons\"."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post a memo in the Commons."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Mr./Ms. Takanashi shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite members to a Space by email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Invited people will receive a confirmation email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once an admin approves, you can join right away."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed for each hiroba."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and Revisions"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all of your devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can edit offline, and changes sync as soon as you reconnect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can restore an earlier version of a page from its Revisions."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Mr. Yamanashi recovered a sentence he had accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tips for organizing"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Pinning important pages is handy."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes in Hiroba become easier to find when you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Takanashi-san organizes tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The same tag can also be used for a short note."}]}
{"t":[{"id":0,"text":"In search, you can look for both Hiroba and hitokoto at the same time."},{"id":1,"text":"If you can't find something, try widening the search range."}]}
